profile.headline: Computer Science graduate and Enterprise Support Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Applecare Advisor with a demonstrated history of working in the consumer electronics industry. Skilled in Computer Science, Management, XCode, Visual Studio, Swift (Programming Language), and Software Development. Strong information technology professional with a Bachelor of Science - BS in Computer Science from University of Houston-Downtown.

positions.title: AppleCare Software Engineer
positions.insights: Software Development, Python (Programming Language) and +3 skills

positions.title: AppleCare Enterprise Technical Support Engineer
positions.description:
Handle inbound support cases, technical support hand-offs, and support exceptions.
Engage in high profile customer meetings.
Track and create issues while working directly with product engineering.
Develop internal technical documentation and maintain lab resources.

positions.title: AppleCare Senior Advisor
positions.description:
Connect with customers to resolve complex problems for iOS, macOS and Windows devices with dynamic solutions.

Accomplishments and Responsibilities:
Excellence Award for 2018
Accept inbound escalations from first level support advisors
Tailor communication for different audiences
Self-manage in a fast-paced at-home environment across multiple systems and applications
Exceptional time management
Ownership of the customer experience with comprehensive resolutions.

positions.title: Lead Programmer
positions.description: Lead programmer for interactive software development studio focused on Unity Engine games for PC.

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description: Develop software used by auto dealerships in management of their service orders.

positions.title: In Home Technician
positions.description:
Delivered high quality on-site computer service for personal and small business customers with minimal managerial oversight.

Accomplishments and Responsibilities:
Higher than district average for customer satisfaction 
Completion of service tickets with reduced secondary contact
Maintenance of all personal equipment, scheduling, and professional relationships
Configuration and installation of new computer and networking hardware for personal and small business use
Perform Windows PC and Mac service in-store, on-site, and remote
